description: This is the story of a fictional band, called The Submariners. They travel to Pensacola, Florida to play a show at ZombieFest. Soon into their festival experience, they realize that this music festival is ground zero for a real life zombie outbreak. Follow SwitchBlade, NoBoy, and DoDo on their journey to Zombiefest.
